# resilience

Timeouts before retries, retry with backoff+jitter, circuit breaker and bulkhead - the AWS Builders' Library canon behind the AF-RES family and AF-PERF-005/007.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model resilience --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show resilience`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-PERF-005, AF-PERF-007, AF-PERF-101, AF-PERF-102, AF-PERF-103, AF-PERF-104, AF-PERF-105, AF-PERF-106, AF-PERF-107, AF-PERF-108
